title: The archery challenge
description: In the Moon Room the player picks up the bow, and ARCHERY CHALLENGE BEGINS IN 3... counts down as three bat-shaped targets fly up and down at the right. The 60-second timer starts, and he shoots an arrow every two seconds: one hits the nearest target for a point, and a new one flies in from the top in its place; six seconds later another arrow hits it for a second point.
